act: 1 to 128 characters, each A-Z, a-z, 0-9, '.', '_', ':' or '-'
amount: 0 or more
amount: in usd a positive amount to the cent; in tokens or calls a whole number, 1 or more
as LimitRequest's without kind, as ThresholdRequest's with it
calls: whole number, 1 or more, or null
caps: each key a catalogue entry's id, 1 to 96 characters; each amount as a usd limit's
count: whole number, 1 or more
day: YYYY-MM-DD
each field 1 to 120 characters, or null; no field but these six
effort: a lowercase word of 1 to 16 letters
effort: a lowercase word of 1 to 16 letters (EFFORT_WORD_MAX)
entry_id: 1 to 96 characters, each A-Z, a-z, 0-9, '.', '_', ':' or '-'
entry_id: required, 1 to 96 characters, each A-Z, a-z, 0-9, '.', '_', ':' or '-'
error_class: one of HEALTH_ERROR_CLASSES, or null; required when outcome is error
field: kind, level or owner
field: owner, scope, unit, period, amount, inclusive, use, count or entry_id
field: what or day
id: 1 to 128 characters, each A-Z, a-z, 0-9, '.', '_' or '-'
inclusive: only on a limit of one kind of use
input_tokens, output_tokens, cache_read_input_tokens, cache_creation_input_tokens, reasoning_tokens: whole numbers, 0 or more, or null
key: `ai-limit:<owner>:<scope>:<unit>:<period>:<period_start>`, stable per owner, limit and period
key: `ai-provider-limit:<owner>:<kind>:<resets_at, or none>`, stable per owner, kind and reset time
key: `ai-threshold:<owner>:<scope>:<unit>:<period>:<kind>:<level>:<period_start>`
key: `explore-ask:<owner>:<day>`
key: `retesting-off:<owner>:<turned_off_at>`
kind: one of PROVIDER_LIMIT_KINDS (spend, quota, rate_window, plan_window)
kind: percent or amount; a percent needs a limit of the same scope, unit and period
level: a percent a whole number, THRESHOLD_PERCENT_MIN to THRESHOLD_PERCENT_MAX (1 to 99); an amount as a limit's amount in its unit
member, usage and calls as `countUsage` bounds them
member: `member:<id>`, `member:<id>/<token>` or `<id>`, the id 1 to 128 characters, each A-Z, a-z, 0-9, '.', '_' or '-'; never a machine identity, `class:` or `token:`
mode: 1 to 40 characters, not blank
mode: `ask` or `draft`
model: at most 120 characters
outcome: one of HEALTH_OUTCOMES (result, refused, silent, error, limit)
owner, member, use, mode, usage and calls are required (calls may be null)
owner, scope, unit and period as a limit's (R2)
owner: `group`, `project:<id>` or `member:<id>`
owner: `group`, `project:<id>`, `member:<id>` or `not recorded`
period: YYYY-MM or YYYY-MM-DD
period: day or month
period_start: the period's first local day, YYYY-MM-DD
provider_figures.source: 1 to 40 characters, each a-z or '_'
resets_at: an instant, or null
scope: `overall`, one of ai-accounts' USE_KINDS, or `per_member` (not on a member's account)
scope: account or entry; an entry-scoped limit names its entry_id
total_cost_usd, estimated_cost_usd: dollar amounts, 0 or more, or null
unit: a currency unit, 3 to 8 lowercase letters (usd)
unit: usd only where the owner holds an account and every one's plan money is reported or priced (ai-catalogue R16)
unit: usd, tokens or calls
unstated: each at most 60 characters
use: one of ai-accounts' USE_KINDS
word: `ai.refused.limit.overall` (also for a re-test cap), `ai.refused.limit.member` or `ai.refused.limit`, by the limit's scope
word: `ai.refused.limit.provider` with a reset time, else `ai.refused.limit.provider.unknown`
word: `ai.refused.limit.unjudged`

act: 1 to 128 characters, each A-Z, a-z, 0-9, '.', '_', ':' or '-'
amount: 0 or more
amount: in usd a positive amount to the cent; in tokens or calls a whole number, 1 or more
as LimitRequest's without kind, as ThresholdRequest's with it
calls: whole number, 1 or more, or null
caps: each key a catalogue entry's id, 1 to 96 characters; each amount as a usd limit's
count: whole number, 1 or more
day: YYYY-MM-DD
each field 1 to 120 characters, or null; no field but these six
effort: a lowercase word of 1 to 16 letters
effort: a lowercase word of 1 to 16 letters (EFFORT_WORD_MAX)
entry_id: 1 to 96 characters, each A-Z, a-z, 0-9, '.', '_', ':' or '-'
entry_id: required, 1 to 96 characters, each A-Z, a-z, 0-9, '.', '_', ':' or '-'
error_class: one of HEALTH_ERROR_CLASSES, or null; required when outcome is error
field: kind, level or owner
field: owner, scope, unit, period, amount, inclusive, use, count or entry_id
field: what or day
id: 1 to 128 characters, each A-Z, a-z, 0-9, '.', '_' or '-'
inclusive: only on a limit of one kind of use
input_tokens, output_tokens, cache_read_input_tokens, cache_creation_input_tokens, reasoning_tokens: whole numbers, 0 or more, or null
key: `ai-limit:<owner>:<scope>:<unit>:<period>:<period_start>`, stable per owner, limit and period
key: `ai-provider-limit:<owner>:<kind>:<resets_at, or none>`, stable per owner, kind and reset time
key: `ai-threshold:<owner>:<scope>:<unit>:<period>:<kind>:<level>:<period_start>`
key: `explore-ask:<owner>:<day>`
key: `retesting-off:<owner>:<turned_off_at>`
kind: one of PROVIDER_LIMIT_KINDS (spend, quota, rate_window, plan_window)
kind: percent or amount; a percent needs a limit of the same scope, unit and period
level: a percent a whole number, THRESHOLD_PERCENT_MIN to THRESHOLD_PERCENT_MAX (1 to 99); an amount as a limit's amount in its unit
member, usage and calls as `countUsage` bounds them
member: `member:<id>`, `member:<id>/<token>` or `<id>`, the id 1 to 128 characters, each A-Z, a-z, 0-9, '.', '_' or '-'; never a machine identity, `class:` or `token:`
mode: 1 to 40 characters, not blank
mode: `ask` or `draft`
model: at most 120 characters
outcome: one of HEALTH_OUTCOMES (result, refused, silent, error, limit)
owner, member, use, mode, usage and calls are required (calls may be null)
owner, scope, unit and period as a limit's (R2)
owner: `group`, `project:<id>` or `member:<id>`
owner: `group`, `project:<id>`, `member:<id>` or `not recorded`
period: YYYY-MM or YYYY-MM-DD
period: day or month
period_start: the period's first local day, YYYY-MM-DD
provider_figures.source: 1 to 40 characters, each a-z or '_'
resets_at: an instant, or null
scope: `overall`, one of ai-accounts' USE_KINDS, or `per_member` (not on a member's account)
scope: account or entry; an entry-scoped limit names its entry_id
total_cost_usd, estimated_cost_usd: dollar amounts, 0 or more, or null
unit: a currency unit, 3 to 8 lowercase letters (usd)
unit: usd only where the owner holds an account and every one's plan money is reported or priced (ai-catalogue R16)
unit: usd, tokens or calls
unstated: each at most 60 characters
use: one of ai-accounts' USE_KINDS
word: `ai.refused.limit.overall` (also for a re-test cap), `ai.refused.limit.member` or `ai.refused.limit`, by the limit's scope
word: `ai.refused.limit.provider` with a reset time, else `ai.refused.limit.provider.unknown`
word: `ai.refused.limit.unjudged`

act: 1 to 128 characters, each A-Z, a-z, 0-9, '.', '_', ':' or '-'
amount: 0 or more
amount: in usd a positive amount to the cent; in tokens or calls a whole number, 1 or more
calls: whole number, 1 or more, or null
caps: each key a catalogue entry's id, 1 to 96 characters; each amount as a usd limit's
count: whole number, 1 or more
day: YYYY-MM-DD
each field 1 to 120 characters, or null; no field but these six
effort: a lowercase word of 1 to 16 letters
effort: a lowercase word of 1 to 16 letters (EFFORT_WORD_MAX)
entry_id: 1 to 96 characters, each A-Z, a-z, 0-9, '.', '_', ':' or '-'
entry_id: required, 1 to 96 characters, each A-Z, a-z, 0-9, '.', '_', ':' or '-'
error_class: one of HEALTH_ERROR_CLASSES, or null; required when outcome is error
field: kind, level or owner
field: owner, scope, unit, period, amount, inclusive, use, count or entry_id
field: what or day
id: 1 to 128 characters, each A-Z, a-z, 0-9, '.', '_' or '-'
inclusive: only on a limit of one kind of use
input_tokens, output_tokens, cache_read_input_tokens, cache_creation_input_tokens, reasoning_tokens: whole numbers, 0 or more, or null
key: `ai-limit:<owner>:<scope>:<unit>:<period>:<period_start>`, stable per owner, limit and period
key: `ai-provider-limit:<owner>:<kind>:<resets_at, or none>`, stable per owner, kind and reset time
key: `ai-threshold:<owner>:<scope>:<unit>:<period>:<kind>:<level>:<period_start>`
key: `explore-ask:<owner>:<day>`
key: `retesting-off:<owner>:<turned_off_at>`
kind: one of PROVIDER_LIMIT_KINDS (spend, quota, rate_window, plan_window)
kind: percent or amount; a percent needs a limit of the same scope, unit and period
level: a percent a whole number, THRESHOLD_PERCENT_MIN to THRESHOLD_PERCENT_MAX (1 to 99); an amount as a limit's amount in its unit
member, usage and calls as `countUsage` bounds them
member: `member:<id>`, `member:<id>/<token>` or `<id>`, the id 1 to 128 characters, each A-Z, a-z, 0-9, '.', '_' or '-'; never a machine identity, `class:` or `token:`
mode: 1 to 40 characters, not blank
mode: `ask` or `draft`
model: at most 120 characters
outcome: one of HEALTH_OUTCOMES (result, refused, silent, error, limit)
owner, member, use, mode, usage and calls are required (calls may be null)
owner, scope, unit and period as a limit's (R2)
owner: `group`, `project:<id>` or `member:<id>`
owner: `group`, `project:<id>`, `member:<id>` or `not recorded`
period: YYYY-MM or YYYY-MM-DD
period: day or month
period_start: the period's first local day, YYYY-MM-DD
provider_figures.source: 1 to 40 characters, each a-z or '_'
resets_at: an instant, or null
scope: `overall`, one of ai-accounts' USE_KINDS, or `per_member` (not on a member's account)
scope: account or entry; an entry-scoped limit names its entry_id
total_cost_usd, estimated_cost_usd: dollar amounts, 0 or more, or null
unit: a currency unit, 3 to 8 lowercase letters (usd)
unit: usd only where the owner holds an account and every one's plan money is reported or priced (ai-catalogue R16)
unit: usd, tokens or calls
unstated: each at most 60 characters
use: one of ai-accounts' USE_KINDS
word: `ai.refused.limit.overall` (also for a re-test cap), `ai.refused.limit.member` or `ai.refused.limit`, by the limit's scope
word: `ai.refused.limit.provider` with a reset time, else `ai.refused.limit.provider.unknown`
word: `ai.refused.limit.unjudged`
